spot.html_text: Theists have traditionally recognized a number of limits on God’s actions. For instance, it is common to insist that God’s omnipotence does not imply that God can do impossible things, such as create a stone that would be too heavy for even God to lift. It is also common to insist that God cannot do anything intrinsically evil, if there are such things, because God is morally perfect. (For a discussion of petitionary prayers for bad things, see Smilansky 2012.) God’s power plus God’s goodness to
